quantity: First-term absorption deficit in proposal years 2-4 relative to year 1 (pp).
comparison: First-term vs re-elected sponsors, step form.
supporting_result: Year-1 indicator near zero and years 2-4 indicator between -3 and -2pp.
decisive_metric: Step interaction and 95 percent interval, flexible year effects.
falsifying_result: Linear form fits better than the step, or year-1 indicator beyond 1pp in magnitude.

lit_a.quoted_prediction: Counting these “hitchhiker” bills as additional cases of bill sponsorship success reveals a more productive, less hierarchical, and less partisan lawmaking process.

claims.quantity: Absorption step after reweighting first-term bills to the re-elected committee distribution (pp).
claims.supporting_result: Reweighted step attenuates by at least half (at or above -1.49pp).
claims.decisive_metric: Reweighted step point estimate against the raw step.
claims.falsifying_result: Step survives reweighting at more than half its raw size.

claims.quantity: First-term minus re-elected strict passage rate among year-1 member bills (pp).
claims.decisive_metric: Adjusted year-1 gap and 95 percent interval.

spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A linear trajectory would mean the deficit is gradual, not a step.

spec_plan.sample_def: member bills 17th-22nd, first-term bills reweighted to the re-elected assembly x committee distribution
spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A step that shrinks by half would mean committee mix explains the deficit.

spec_plan.sample_def: member-year cells with at least 3 bills, equal weights
spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: No step at the member level would mean prolific sponsors carry the bill-level estimate.

spec_plan.model: TOST on the adjusted year-1 gap, margin 2pp
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: An interval outside the margin would mean the premise null cannot be called equivalent to zero.

spec_plan.outcome_def: absorbed into a committee alternative, permuted within assembly term
spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: An estimate of similar size on permuted outcomes would mean the primary estimate is produced by the specification, not the data.

spec_plan.model: LPM absorbed ~ first_term x years2to4 + year FE + assembly FE + bloc + election_type + committee FE, clustered by sponsor
spec_plan.what_result_would_mean: A sign that flips across subsamples would mean a few legislators carry the estimate.
